finding: L2 gate C1-C4 passes (post-hoc); the union label is the least biased single target
evidence_value: L_comb 971 positives (16.9%; weighted 14.0%); C1 15.7%/25.7% missed by single labels; C3 Asian L_comb 50
decision: Freeze L_comb = DIQ010==1 or LBXGH>=6.5 on N=5,730 (tag target-freeze); any change requires a register entry and reopening L2
alternatives_rejected: Freeze L_self (misses 152 undiagnosed); freeze L_A1c (misses 250 controlled); borderline positive (SL3, kept as sensitivity)
check_note: Gate recomputed in §5.8; post-hoc nature stated

finding: Self-report and HbA1c are two different instruments with moderate-to-substantial agreement
decision: Use the union L_comb as training target; report PA/NA next to kappa; keep L_self and L_A1c as sensitivity labels SL2/SL1
alternatives_rejected: Single-instrument label (L_self or L_A1c) as target; kappa alone (prevalence-dependent)
check_note: Confusion table, kappa, PA/NA, sens/PPV recomputed and asserted against the verified reference values

finding: Treatment masks diabetes in HbA1c: an HbA1c-only label turns controlled patients into negatives
evidence_value: 250/819 (30.5%) self-reported diabetics have HbA1c<6.5; 165 of them on medication; 23.8% of treated patients below 6.5
decision: Reject L_A1c as the sole target; keep stratum D_controlled as a 3x3 evaluation column; medication is audit-only (post-diagnosis)
alternatives_rejected: HbA1c-only target; medication as a feature (leakage by the availability rule)

finding: Most undiagnosed adults had contact with the health system: the gap is diagnosis/communication, not only access
evidence_value: undiagnosed adults blood-tested in past 3 y: 62.5% weighted (KG 53.5%-70.9%; sample 104/152 = 68%); 36/152 told borderline; 48 told prediabetes
decision: Frame E-SCREEN positives as 'not diagnosed despite contact'; DIQ160/DIQ180 excluded as features (post-test information); borderline kept negative in L_comb and flagged
alternatives_rejected: Describe undiagnosed as 'no access to care'; use DIQ180 as a screening feature

finding: Undiagnosed share is higher without insurance or a usual place of care; small cells do not meet NCHS standards
evidence_value: RD uninsured-insured 23.2pp (6.2, 40.1); uninsured share 43.0% KG width 0.39; DAG-adjusted OR (age, sex, PIR) uninsured 2.22 (1.18, 4.18), weighted 2.90 (1.48, 5.67); no usual place 2.76 (1.43, 5.33), weighted 2.52 (0.89, 7.09)
decision: Headline = risk difference with JK CI (df of the contrast domain; conservative df of the smaller group also shown); proportions with KG CI and NCHS flag; insurance and access are audit/stratification variables only; S8 audits L_self vs L_comb by low_access
alternatives_rejected: Report small-cell proportions as headline; drop small groups; put insurance into the model; one mutually adjusted model (adjusts insurance for its mediator usual care; Table-2 fallacy)

finding: BMI under-measures diabetes-relevant adiposity in NH Asian adults; WHtR recovers discrimination
evidence_value: BMI<25 among diabetics: Asian 24/47 (51.1%) vs White 7.2%; AUC gain WHtR-BMI Asian +0.137 (0.093, 0.181) vs White +0.049
decision: Pre-register P14 (WHtR replaces waist, BMI kept) as S8 mitigation arm with White control; Asian results exploratory (40 A1c-positive cases); no group-specific thresholds
alternatives_rejected: Race-specific BMI cut-offs in the model; adding WHtR on top of waist (redundant); race x BMI interaction (not detectable, §4.12)

finding: Cohort over-represents older adults; exam participants report more diabetes than interview-only adults
evidence_value: 60+: sample 46.2% vs weighted 31.4%; Kish deff 1.55; self-report interview-only 8.8% vs with HbA1c 11.7%; response 34.6%/25.7%
decision: Descriptive population estimates use WTPH2YR with PSU jackknife; survey-weighted training only as ablation B6b; claims scoped to the examined population
alternatives_rejected: Treat the unweighted sample as the population; claim national representativeness of model metrics

finding: HbA1c is missing more often for NH Black adults; WTPH2YR adjustment changes prevalence by 0.1 pp
evidence_value: missing HbA1c: Black 9.3% vs White 4.0%; prevalence MEC 13.9% vs PH 14.0%; Manski width overall 0.042
decision: Keep complete-case cohort with WTPH2YR; report Manski bounds; IPW sensitivity deferred to S9 (§9.7)
alternatives_rejected: Impute HbA1c (would impute the label); ignore missingness

finding: 84% of L_comb positives are already diagnosed, so E-ALL measures recognition of known disease
evidence_value: E-SCREEN: 4911 adults, 152 positives vs 4759 negatives; borderline kept with 36 positive; 3x3 strata 569/250/152/4759
decision: E-SCREEN (DIQ010!=1, y = HbA1c>=6.5) is a co-primary evaluation population next to E-ALL; 3x3 label matrix (SL6) evaluated in S8 at specificity 0.80
alternatives_rejected: Evaluate on E-ALL only; train on E-SCREEN only (152 events too few)

finding: Label definition is a researcher degree of freedom; robustness needs pre-specified alternatives
decision: Freeze SL1-SL7 as executable definitions (src/labels.py); SL4 uses only the DIQ070 universe and excludes pills of non-diagnosed respondents; S9 reports results under SL1-SL5, S8 runs SL6, S9 runs SL7
alternatives_rejected: Ad-hoc relabelling after seeing model results; DIQ070 pills as diabetes for all respondents (would count pills plausibly taken for prediabetes, e.g. metformin)
